headline: Minimum RMG wage set at Tk17,000 after vote; workers' side accept with reservations
summary: Bangladesh's minimum wage for ready-made garment workers was set at Tk17,000 after a vote, with workers' representatives accepting it with reservations. The labour ministry will make the final decision.
why: Ready-made garments are Bangladesh's dominant export industry, so wage levels affect production costs for global apparel brands.
